body:
_Migrated from issue #1350, filed 2026-08-04._

Found by the v4.1.29 pre-tag refuter gate. Not a regression — before #1344 the custom-column
branch didn't write `ub.ReadBook` at all — but it makes #1344 an incomplete fix.

## Symptom

On an install where an admin has pointed Calibre-Web at a custom column for read status,
marking a book Read in the web UI does not reach the Kobo, for any book the device has no
reading state for yet. A/B in one container, same book, same auth token, only
`config_read_column` differs:

| `config_read_column` | `kobo_reading_state` rows after toggleread | Kobo `/v1/library/sync` wire |
|---|---|---|
| `0` (default) | 1 | `ChangedReadingState StatusInfo.Status='Finished'` |
| `4` (custom column) | 0 | no ReadingState for the book at all |

Not on an incremental sync, and not on a full first-ever sync from a fresh token. Once the
device has synced the book once the toggle does get through, so this affects books the device
hasn't seen yet.

## Root cause

The default branch of `helper.edit_book_read_status` builds the whole state graph
(`helper.py:857-861`):

```python
if not book.kobo_reading_state:
    kobo_reading_state = ub.KoboReadingState(user_id=current_user.id, book_id=book_id)
    kobo_reading_state.current_bookmark = ub.KoboBookmark()
    kobo_reading_state.statistics = ub.KoboStatistics()
    book.kobo_reading_state = kobo_reading_state
```

The custom-column branch instead calls `mirror_read_status_to_readbook`, which by design
touches only `row.read_status` (`helper.py:829`). `ub.receive_before_flush` bumps the Kobo
delta key only `if change.kobo_reading_state` (`ub.py:1142`) — `None` here — and the Kobo
sync is keyed exclusively on that `last_modified` (`cps/kobo.py:544`, `:683`). So nothing is
ever emitted.

## Fix direction

`cps/progress_syncing/protocols/kosync.py:369` already has `_ensure_visible_reading_state`,
which idempotently builds exactly this graph and exists for the same reason (#627: ReadBook
rows that predate Kobo state). Reuse it from the mirror rather than adding a second copy, so
both branches build the state the same way and there's one source of truth for what the graph
looks like.

Regression test to pin: on a custom-column install, marking read a book with no prior
`KoboReadingState` must leave a `ReadBook` row that *has* a reading state, so the flush hook
bumps `last_modified` and the delta emits.

## Release note

v4.1.29 says "Both now follow the same toggle." That is true at the database level (both
carriers are updated) but not at the device level for these books. The v4.1.29 note has been
worded to match what actually ships; this issue is the work that would make the stronger
claim true.
title: Custom-column mark-read never reaches the Kobo for a book with no prior reading state
